Plan: (1) GitSync companionRef + atomic push. (2) src/storage/worktree.ts: capture (tmp index copy, add -u, ls-files --others --exclude-standard, I/U/W stash commits), wrapper chain refs/pi/worktrees/<n> (parents [prev,W], tree=W tree, trailers Thread-Tip/Thread-Entry/Branch/Head/Skipped), restore (branch cases, stash apply --index fallback, conflicts, failed->clean), uniqueWork guard. (3) src/worktree.ts: doc pi-action.worktree rewindable/asOf written with tx.appendEntry marker in same commit (fork asOf uses entry commitSeq); checkpoint at boundaries+close; restore before harness.resume(); restore msg via write entry with model user message; guard question via ui.ask select; after restoring non-latest, append new wrapper so latest==chosen. (4) push.ts: open GitStorage+Harness (no resume) to snapshot+doc. (5) inputs worktree_snapshots, _max_file_mb,_max_total_mb,_exclude. Shallow clones: deepen before ancestry checks.
</model-note>
